VERIFICATION (verify_li_2021_org_cultural_diversity.R, PARTIAL): route 1 -- refitting the paper's one-factor OCD CFA on its five retained items reproduces Table 2 (published loadings 0.677/0.707/0.864/0.802/0.765 for OCD2/4/6/7/9 vs observed 0.6772/0.7072/0.8645/0.8022/0.7650; R-SQUARE max deviation 0.0013, n=336), and the identity is uniquely best of 15,120 ordered 5-of-9 assignments (SSD 0.000000 vs 0.000688 runner-up) -- this pins the live columns to the paper's codes, not the text. Route 5/8 -- a 2-factor promax EFA puts OCD6-OCD9 on one factor (loadings 0.641/0.545/0.777/0.957), wholly inside the shipped responsiveness block (chance 5/126 = 0.040 under a random text permutation), and the two 'informal' items OCD1 and OCD3 co-load (0.852/0.745, r=0.54). NOT established: the 4|5 sub-block boundary -- OCD5 ('trusts outsiders') loads with the management-style items (0.729), and the contiguous 1-4/5-9 two-factor CFA ranks 6th of 126 four/five splits (chi2 154.0 vs best 118.0 for {OCD1,OCD3,OCD4,OCD5}; factor r 0.89, so the test is underpowered). This is read as a property of the instrument in this sample, not as evidence of a mis-mapping, but it means the OCD4/OCD5 boundary rests on listing order alone, as does order within each sub-block.
